items.title: Reel Time: The Christophers
items.description: Reel Time features some of the best films from the Toronto International Film Festival. Organized by Banff Centre, Reel Time has brought alternative cinema to the Bow Valley for over fifteen years.

items.title: Decolonizing the Narrative Conversation Series with Leelay Gilday
items.description: Join us for a conversation with singer/songwriter Leelay Gilday, Banff Centre alumna, former program faculty, and featured artist. items.title: William Prince | On Rolls The Wheel Tour
items.description: JUNO Award-winning singer-songwriter William Prince brings his On Rolls The Wheel Tour to Banff Centre on November 20 for an intimate acoustic performance.

items.title: Literary Cabaret: Early Career Writers of Poetry - Stanza 1
items.description: As part of Banff Centre's Literary Cabaret series, featuring the Early Career Writers of Poetry's Residency at Banff Centre, join us for an evening celebrating the next generation of storytellers, bards and troubadours.

items.title: Mâwacihitowinihk Nikamowak: A Gathering of Indigenous Musicians
items.description: Mâwacihitowinihk Nikamowak is Plains Cree for "they sing at the gathering (place)," referring to Sacred Guardian Buffalo Mountain, where Banff Centre campus resides. items.title: BIRDY | Hung Dance
items.description: On November 28, Banff Centre Presents brings bold contemporary dance to the mountains with BIRDY, an electrifying work from Taiwan’s acclaimed Hung Dance.

items.title: Blackfoot Confederacy and Town of Banff enter new phase of cooperation
items.description: Blackfoot Confederacy and the Town of Banff have formally signed a Memorandum of Understanding on communication and cooperation, establishing a framework for continued engagement, stronger working relationships and collaboration.

items.title: Mo Valley Mile & 5K — November 29
items.description: The Mo Valley Mile & 5K is back for a third year in Banff! To promote physical and mental well-being during Movember, you can choose between a quick mile or a bit of a longer distance with a 5K.

items.title: Winter Solstice Community Lantern Skate — December 21
items.description: Banff and Bow Valley residents, create your own beautiful lantern! We will all light up our lanterns for an evening skate, where we will enjoy some live local music and stay warm sipping hot tea by the fire.

items.title: Banff residents can now recycle more
items.description: Plastic bags, styrofoam, candy wrappers, coffee cups among materials that can now be diverted from landfill!

items.title: New drop-in recreation sessions offer more ways to use your Pauw Pass
items.description: From badminton to roller disco, and soccer to pickleball, there is something for everyone in the Town of Banff’s updated drop-in recreation schedule.
